affected_subject.reason: Identifies FastAccessVault.rebalanceFunds() and related processTransfer/custodian operations.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: any user calling rebalanceFunds() without access control, including after processTransfer and during external transfer.

direct_effect.reason: Immediate effects: unauthorized rebalancing/custodian transfers, temporary under-collateralization, failed redemptions, and possible double-drain via reentrancy.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Derives authorization (no access control) and state/conservation relations (under-collateralization, double-drain, failed redemptions).

summary: Report fragments identify the affected function, concrete unauthorized trigger, immediate effects, and authorization/state safety relations sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
